title.zh: 五官与神志病：眼耳病不拘“肝开窍于目”，风池三个方向，失眠先问再察经、先清后补
title.en: Sense Organs and Mind: Eye and Ear Disease Not Bound by "Liver Opens into the Eyes", Three Directions for Fengchi, Insomnia Asked Fully, Palpated, Then Cleared before Tonifying

summary.zh: 五官章的絮语说明眼病要依症候与察经，不可拘泥经方验方：案117是肝病，案116却是太阳经受损，与肝无关；风池针刺有三个方向。耳与颌关节病多按经筋和井穴处理。神志章的失眠讨论先问睡眠与梦境，分心肾不交、心包郁热、心脾不足三型并加阳明不和，各有配穴；病例显示他先清厥阴郁热，再补肝肾，最后才交通心肾。
summary.en: The sense-organ essays say eye disease must follow symptoms and palpation, not stock or proven formulas: Case 117 is a Liver disease, while Case 116 is Taiyang damage unrelated to the Liver; Fengchi has three needling directions. Ear and jaw-joint disease are mostly handled as sinew and jing-well problems. In the mind chapter the insomnia essay first asks about sleep and dreams, separates Heart-Kidney disharmony, pericardium depressed heat and Heart-Spleen insufficiency, adds Yangming disharmony, and gives points for each; the cases show him clearing Jueyin depressed heat first, then tonifying Liver and Kidney, and only last joining Heart and Kidney.

takeaways.zh: 眼病不能只想“肝开窍于目”：案117的目干涩是脂肪肝诱发，属《内经》所说肝开窍于目；案116是双眼皮整容术引发的目干涩，与肝无关，是太阳经受损。因此治眼病必须依靠具体症候和经络异常分析，不可拘泥经方、验方。案116解读也说肝目联系主要与视功能和眼底病有关，此例不是，所以未取厥阴经穴；上眼睑与小趾同在足太阳线上，取太阳经并配相表里的少阴经(水泉)，用“阳病取阴”，还至阴放血，12诊显效。
takeaways.en: Eye disease is not just "the Liver opens into the eyes". Case 117's dry eyes were brought on by fatty liver, the Neijing's Liver-opens-into-the-eyes; Case 116's dry eyes followed double-eyelid cosmetic surgery, had nothing to do with the Liver, and were Taiyang damage. So eye disease must rest on the actual symptoms and channel findings, not fixed or proven formulas. The Case 116 comment adds that the Liver-eye link mainly concerns visual function and fundus disease, which this was not, so no Jueyin points were taken; the upper eyelid and little toe both lie on Foot Taiyang, so he took Taiyang with the paired Shaoyin (Shuiquan) by "yang disease, take yin", and bled Zhiyin: marked effect in 12 visits.

takeaways.zh: 太阴与太阳互助有条件：案117他取尺泽、阴陵泉配阳谷、阳陵泉，并说不能随便用太阳来帮太阴或反过来。阳经善泻、阴经善补：外邪侵袭太阴属实证，可选太阳；内伤影响太阳(如膀胱气化障碍)属虚证，应选太阴。本案无外邪，取太阳是为了帮助少阳枢转，像开风扇(枢)还要开窗(开)通气；病为太阴、少阳并病，所以没有把太冲、行间当主穴。
takeaways.en: Taiyin and Taiyang help each other only under conditions. In Case 117 he took Chize and Yinlingquan with Yanggu and Yanglingquan, and says Taiyang must not be used casually to help Taiyin or the reverse. Yang channels drain well, yin channels tonify well: external attack on Taiyin is excess and Taiyang may be chosen; internal damage affecting Taiyang (for example impaired bladder qi transformation) is deficiency and Taiyin should be chosen. Here there was no external factor, and Taiyang was taken to help Shaoyang pivot, like opening a window (opening) as well as running a fan (pivot) to ventilate; the disease was a combined Taiyin and Shaoyang one, so Taichong and Xingjian were not the main points.

takeaways.zh: 风池有三个针刺方向：向患侧治单侧头痛、眼肌病变、血管阻塞；向对侧眼睛(健侧)进针低于1寸治眼底病或视神经疾病；横刺向中线治督脉或头后部疾病，包括颈椎病、脑供血不足。他的按语要求：风池宜平刺，切不可向内上方针刺以免发生事故，一般1～1.2寸深度即可得气。
takeaways.en: Fengchi has three needling directions: toward the affected side for one-sided headache, eye-muscle disease and vascular blockage; toward the opposite (healthy) eye, less than 1 cun deep, for fundus disease or optic nerve disease; transversely toward the midline for Du or occipital disease, including cervical spondylosis and insufficient cerebral blood supply. His note requires flat insertion and never inward-upward to avoid accidents, de qi usually at 1-1.2 cun.

takeaways.zh: 耳病不都是肾：案114他说肾开窍于耳，但并非各种耳聋耳鸣都属于肾；察经见手足少阳与手阳明异常为暴聋的病经，另见手足厥阴、足太阴异常属妇科病经，前六诊清泻少阳取外关、足临泣、风池，并在患侧关冲、商阳、耳尖放血，18诊显效，1年后未复发。案115耳闭塞察经仅太阳异常，判为手太阳经筋病，单取少泽井穴放血6滴配养老，他说取井穴放血宜引阳通络而不宜多，第二天痊愈。
takeaways.en: Ear disease is not always the Kidney. In Case 114 he says the Kidney opens into the ear, but not every deafness or tinnitus belongs to the Kidney; palpation showed Hand and Foot Shaoyang and Hand Yangming as the sudden-deafness channels, and Hand and Foot Jueyin and Foot Taiyin as the gynaecological ones; the first six visits cleared Shaoyang with Waiguan, Zulinqi and Fengchi and bled Guanchong, Shangyang and the ear apex on the affected side: marked effect in 18 visits, no relapse at 1 year. In Case 115 (ear blockage) only Taiyang was abnormal, judged Hand Taiyang sinew disease, and he took the jing-well Shaoze alone, bled 6 drops, with Yanglao; he says a jing-well bleed should lead yang out and not be large; cured next day.

takeaways.zh: 穴的作用由病机条件决定：案115他总结“任何一个穴在不同的病机条件下能治疗不同的病症，离开了病机条件，违背了病机规律，则穴什么病都治不了”，符合病机时不必拘泥文献所载主治，关键是掌握经络气化和经络所属。这是他批评“经验穴、特效穴”的另一面。
takeaways.en: A point's action depends on the pathomechanism. In Case 115 he concludes that any point can treat different diseases under different pathomechanisms, and away from the pathomechanism a point treats nothing; where the pathomechanism fits, one need not stick to the indications in the literature, the key being channel qi transformation and which channel is involved. This is the other side of his criticism of "experience points" and "special-effect points".

takeaways.zh: 视物成双和下颌关节拘急都当经筋病：案118视物成双(甲减，右眼内收不能)察出太阳与少阳异常，按经筋循行取患侧手太阳原穴腕骨、手少阳原穴阳池温阳通络，前顶升阳益气，眉冲、承光舒筋通络，1次后双目转动灵活；案119下颌关节紊乱因下颌处于手少阳、手太阳与手足阳明经筋的循行区，据察经手阳明经筋异常，取头维、合谷、手三里、足三里，2次明显好转。
takeaways.en: Diplopia and jaw-joint contracture are both treated as sinew disease. Case 118 (thyroid hypofunction, right eye unable to adduct) showed Taiyang and Shaoyang changes; following the sinew course he took the affected side's Hand Taiyang yuan point Wangu (SI4) and Hand Shaoyang yuan point Yangchi to warm yang and free the channel, Qianding to lift yang, Meichong and Chengguang to relax the sinew and free the channel; the eyes moved freely after one visit. Case 119 (temporomandibular disorder): the jaw joint lies where the Hand Shaoyang, Hand Taiyang and both Yangming sinews run; palpation showed the Hand Yangming sinew abnormal, so Touwei, Hegu, Shousanli and Zusanli; clearly better after 2 visits.

takeaways.zh: 失眠先问全，再与察经对接：他要先了解入睡难否、易醒否、早醒否、做梦否，梦的种类(梦恐属肾，惊怒属肝，悲哀属肺，连续性的属脾)；易醒是睡眠浅，多为心肾不交、心火上亢；入睡困难一般为肾阴不足、阴不纳阳。他说凡阳不入阴皆可致失眠，大都以心肾不交为基础，但要靠察经反应与症候对接才辨经选经。三种常见证型是心肾不交、心包有郁热、心脾不足，另外阳明不和(胃不和则卧不安)也致失眠。案122脑出血后失眠，他说失眠一般先想三阴经，但察出太阳经明显异常，故取天柱、玉枕、后顶搓针，配内关、公孙。
takeaways.en: Ask about insomnia fully, then join it to palpation. He wants to know whether falling asleep is hard, waking easy, waking early, and dreaming, and what kind of dream (fear belongs to Kidney, anger to Liver, grief to Lung, continuous dreams to Spleen); easy waking is light sleep, mostly Heart-Kidney disharmony with Heart fire rising; difficulty falling asleep is usually Kidney yin insufficiency failing to hold yang. He says any failure of yang to enter yin can cause insomnia, mostly on a basis of Heart-Kidney disharmony, but channel and point choice needs the palpation findings joined to the symptoms. The three common patterns are Heart-Kidney disharmony, pericardium depressed heat and Heart-Spleen insufficiency, and Yangming disharmony (a stomach that is not harmonised disturbs sleep) can also cause it. In Case 122 (insomnia after brain haemorrhage) he notes insomnia usually suggests the three yin channels first, but palpation showed marked Taiyang change, so Tianzhu, Yuzhen and Houding rubbing-twirling were used, with Neiguan and Gongsun.

takeaways.zh: 失眠的三型各有一对穴，治疗次序是先清后补：心肾不交取照海、神门、复溜(照海通阴跷，使阳入阴、睡眠深；神门配太溪交通心肾)；厥阴郁热取大陵配行间，或大陵配照海(更年期心烦烘热失眠)；心脾不足取神门配太白或神门配三阴交；阳明不和虚取手足三里、建里，实取内庭、中皖。次序上案125先清解厥阴郁热，症减后补肝肾，最后交通心肾，他说首先需要清热才能交通心肾；案124第二诊过早改用尺泽、阴陵泉化湿，失眠复发，他说改穴太早，宜先清厥阴之火，仍取大陵、行间、照海。
takeaways.en: Each of the three patterns has its own point pairs, and the order is clear first, tonify later. Heart-Kidney disharmony: Zhaohai, Shenmen, Fuliu (Zhaohai connects the Yin Qiao, letting yang enter yin and sleep deepen; Shenmen with Taixi joins Heart and Kidney). Jueyin depressed heat: Daling with Xingjian, or Daling with Zhaohai (menopausal restless heat and insomnia). Heart-Spleen insufficiency: Shenmen with Taibai or Shenmen with Sanyinjiao. Yangming disharmony: in deficiency Hand and Foot Zusanli and Jianli, in excess Neiting and Zhongwan. On order, Case 125 first cleared Jueyin depressed heat, then tonified Liver and Kidney, and last joined Heart and Kidney; he says heat must be cleared first before Heart and Kidney can be joined. In Case 124 he switched too early at the second visit to Chize and Yinlingquan to resolve damp, insomnia returned, and he says the change was premature: clear Jueyin fire first, again with Daling, Xingjian and Zhaohai.

how_to_use.zh: 眼病先看症候与察经，不要只想肝(案116对案117)；失眠先按诊后絮语问睡眠和梦，再与察经对接选表2的配穴，遵循先清厥阴郁热、后补、最后交通心肾的次序(案124、125)。
how_to_use.en: For eye disease look at symptoms and palpation first, not only the Liver (Case 116 against 117); for insomnia ask about sleep and dreams as the essay says, join them to palpation, pick the pair from Table 2, and follow the order of clearing Jueyin heat, tonifying, then joining Heart and Kidney (Cases 124, 125).

caveats.zh: 五官章的“诊后絮语”只有两篇短文，耳病、视物成双、下颌关节病多据案解读，说服力较弱。失眠的三型和配穴对是他的经验归纳，梦境与脏腑对应引自古籍，不是他的新说。OCR：人睡=入睡，心牌=心脾，中皖=中脘，赞竹=攒竹，“手阴经”=手厥阴经，窝=窍，部穴=郄穴；表2最后一行理由取自絮语中“胃不和则卧不安”的提法。“医案解读”按导读也包含整理者的体会和对文献的核对，不全是他本人语。
caveats.en: The sense-organ chapter has only two short essays, so ear disease, diplopia and jaw-joint disease rest mostly on case comments and are less firmly supported. The three insomnia patterns and point pairs are his experience summary, and the dream-organ correspondence is quoted from classical sources, not his own new claim. OCR: 人睡 = 入睡, 心牌 = 心脾, 中皖 = 中脘, 赞竹 = 攒竹, "手阴经" = Hand Jueyin, 窝 = 窍, 部穴 = xi-cleft point; in Table 2 the rationale of the last row is taken from the essay's phrase on the stomach not being harmonised. By the book's own guide the case comments also contain the compilers' reflections and checks of the literature, not only his words.
